description: Expression of scsA, scsB and scsC in Dictyostelium differentiated cell types (EBI Expression Atlas E-MTAB-7215)
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
meta=requests.get('https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/json/experiments/E-MTAB-7215',timeout=60).json()
grp={c['assayGroupId']: c['factorValue'] for c in meta['columnHeaders']}
print('assay groups:', grp)

txt=requests.get('https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/microarray/data/atlas/experiments/E-MTAB-7215/E-MTAB-7215-tpms.tsv',timeout=120).text
lines=[l for l in txt.split('\n') if l.strip()]
hdr=lines[0].split('\t'); gcols=hdr[2:]
targets={'DDB_G0271842':'scsC (Q55AI5, Pro20β)','DDB_G0274449':'scsB (Q869S7, Gln20β)','DDB_G0289325':'scsA alpha (P36967)'}
def med(cell):  # quartile string "q0,q1,median,q3,q4" -> median
    parts=cell.split(',')
    try: return float(parts[len(parts)//2])
    except: return np.nan
rows=[]; allm=[]
for l in lines[1:]:
    p=l.split('\t')
    if len(p)<2+len(gcols): continue
    m=[med(c) for c in p[2:2+len(gcols)]]
    allm.append(m)
    if p[0] in targets: rows.append([targets[p[0]],p[0]]+m)
A=np.array(allm,dtype=float)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['gene','DDB_id']+[grp[g] for g in gcols])
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print('\nMedian TPM (E-MTAB-7215, terminally differentiated Dictyostelium cell types):')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print('\nn genes =',A.shape[0])
for _,rw in df.iterrows():
    v=rw[[grp[g] for g in gcols]].astype(float).values
    pr=[round(float(np.nansum(A[:,i]<v[i])/np.sum(~np.isnan(A[:,i]))*100),1) for i in range(len(v))]
    print(f"{rw['gene']:30s} percentile rank: {pr}")
ratio=df.set_index('gene')[[grp[g] for g in gcols]].astype(float)
print('\nscsB / scsC TPM ratio per cell type:')
print((ratio.loc['scsB (Q869S7, Gln20β)']/ratio.loc['scsC (Q55AI5, Pro20β)']).round(2).to_string())
df.to_csv('dicty_scs_expression_EMTAB7215.csv',index=False)

# figure
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ct=[grp[g] for g in gcols]
x=np.arange(len(ct)); w=0.27
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.4))
cols={'scsA alpha (P36967)':'#4a4a4a','scsB (Q869S7, Gln20β)':'#2f6f4e','scsC (Q55AI5, Pro20β)':'#8c3b3b'}
for i,g in enumerate(['scsA alpha (P36967)','scsB (Q869S7, Gln20β)','scsC (Q55AI5, Pro20β)']):
    ax.bar(x+(i-1)*w, ratio.loc[g].values, w, label=g, color=cols[g])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(ct, rotation=15, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('median TPM'); ax.set_title('Both succinyl-CoA synthetase beta paralogues are expressed in Dictyostelium\n(E-MTAB-7215, terminally differentiated cell types)',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, frameon=False); ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
